study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using normative modelling to detect disease progression in mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease in a cross-sectional multi-cohort study

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Six datasets were used: UK Biobank (n=11,034 HC) for training the normative model; ADNI (n=517; 212 HC, 159 EMCI, 82 LMCI, 64 AD), AIBL (n=346; 262 HC, 46 MCI, 38 AD), ARWiBo (n=319; 215 HC, 67 MCI, 37 AD), OASIS-1 (n=78; 41 HC, 37 AD), and MIRIAD (n=48; 18 HC, 30 AD) for assessing normative model performance on MCI and AD patients. All clinical datasets were restricted to subjects aged 47-73 to match UK Biobank age range.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "In our analysis, we used six datasets: the UK Biobank, the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), the Australian Imaging Biomarkers and Lifestyle Study of Ageing (AIBL), the Alzheimer's Disease Repository Without Borders (ARWiBo), the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies: Cross-Sectional (OASIS-1), and the Minimal Interval Resonance Imaging in Alzheimer's Disease (MIRIAD)."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: UK Biobank (11,034 HC) was used to train the adversarial autoencoder normative model via bootstrapping (1,000 iterations, n=11,032 each). The five clinical datasets (ADNI, AIBL, ARWiBo, OASIS-1, MIRIAD) were used to assess normative model performance by calculating deviation scores for HC, MCI, and AD patients, and for comparison against traditional classifiers (RVM).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "In the present study, we used the UK Biobank set to train the autoencoders and the ADNI, AIBL, ARWiBo, OASIS-1, and MIRIAD datasets to assess the normative model performance on data from patients with MCI and AD."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was trained using 11,034 HC from the UK Biobank. There was no explicit train/validation/test split within the UK Biobank data; instead, robustness was assessed via 1,000 bootstrap iterations (each sampling n=11,032 with replacement). The HC subjects in the five clinical datasets (ADNI: 212, AIBL: 262, ARWiBo: 215, OASIS-1: 41, MIRIAD: 18) were not used for normative model training but for assessing model performance.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Here, we used an early release of the project's data comprising of 11,034 HC participants." ... "We created 1,000 bootstrapped sets (each one with n = 11,032) by sampling with replacement from the UK Biobank."

Since there was no separate validation/test split within UK Biobank, overall-phase and train-phase are identical. Age inclusion criteria: 47-73 years. Mean age 61.6 years, SD 7.0 years, range [47, 73].
